name: Perrigo Company plc

corporate_actions.event: CEO Patrick Lockwood-Taylor resigned (personal conduct, unrelated to business); board member Albert Manzone interim CEO
Infant formula business exit; to be reported as discontinued operations from Q4 2026

geography.fx_notes: Reports USD. Consumer Self-Care Americas c.2/3 of sales (Morningstar description via PitchBook), International (mainly Europe) c.1/3; exact split not collected.

management.senior_turnover_5y: CEO resigned 2026 after code-of-conduct finding; previous CEO Murray Kessler left 2023; high turnover
management.guidance_record: Repeated guidance cuts; first core guidance cut of 2026 in Nov

evidence: Store-brand OTC repeat purchase but retailer-contracted, tender-like (PB description)
A.rationale: Recurring demand but retailer bargaining power.

evidence: Private-label model competes on price; organic declines 2025-26 (S1,S4)

C.rationale: Scale exists but not translating into margin/growth.

evidence: CEO resigned for conduct; interim CEO (S3)
Infant formula exit after heavy investment (S2)
Infant formula supply disruptions; input cost pass-through lag (S2)
Large restructuring/impairment adjustments; core vs all-in gaps (S1)

sector_specific.patent_exposure_pct: <5% (generic/store-brand model; exposure is to Rx-to-OTC switch timing not LOE)
sector_specific.top_product_pct: not disclosed; largest customer Walmart historically >10% of sales (recalled, verify in 10-K)
sector_specific.litigation: Historic Irish Revenue tax assessment and securities litigation (status not re-verified); talc/baby-powder not applicable
sector_specific.reimbursement: Minimal (OTC); infant formula WIC contracts being exited

gates.notes: G1: net leverage 4.0x (S4) >3.5x. G2: CEO resignation for conduct + historic tax/securities disputes -> further evidence. G3: retailer concentration (Walmart) likely >15%? unverified -> B. Not transaction-dominated though infant formula exit and CEO search ongoing.

bull_points: Low valuation and cost programme could restore margins
Rx-to-OTC switches (e.g. Opill) offer optional growth
bear_points: Negative core organic growth and repeated guidance cuts
thesis_breakers: Core organic decline persists into FY2027
Net leverage fails to fall below 3.5x by end-2027
